items.title: 'Darwin’s hypothesis provided an important inspiration': Scientists bolster 150-year-old Darwinian theory with a carnivorous plant in China
items.summary: Researchers have confirmed that a plant native to alpine regions in southwest China is carnivorous, supporting a Darwinian theory from 1875.
items.zh: “达尔文的假说提供了重要的启发”：科学家用中国的一种食肉植物支持了150年前的达尔文理论

items.title: A SpaceX rocket will hit the moon at 5,000 mph tonight. Experts explain what you could see, and when.
items.summary: An upcoming collision of a Falcon 9 rocket part with the moon may be visible from Earth with telescopes, new research suggests. Here's what scientists and skywatchers are hoping to see.
items.zh: 今晚，SpaceX 火箭将以 5,000 英里/小时的速度撞击月球。专家解释了您可以看到什么以及何时看到。

items.title: Is AI making us dumber? Maybe not. But our skills are at risk
items.summary: Studies suggest AI can weaken learning when it replaces effort, but tools that guide rather than answer may help people keep their skills.
items.zh: 人工智能会让我们变得更笨吗？也许不是。但我们的技能面临风险

items.title: Emperor penguin chicks like these starved. An iceberg may be the cause
items.summary: An emperor penguin colony in Antarctica saw a massive decline in chicks in 2025. The contours of a nearby grounded iceberg may have been the cause.
items.zh: 像这样的帝企鹅幼崽都挨饿了。冰山可能是原因

items.title: The benefits of medical AI assistance vary based on user expertise
items.summary: Study finds non-experts deferred to LLM-based diagnostic assistance, even when it was wrong, while clinicians caught AI errors.

items.title: Naked mole-rat queens rule their colonies with a potent odor
items.summary: A compound made only by breeding queens keeps naked mole-rat colonies infertile and free of conflict.
items.zh: 裸鼹鼠女王用强烈的气味统治它们的殖民地

items.summary: Female pied flycatchers can tell whether a male is paired or not based on song differences. Mated males sing shorter songs and repeat syllables less.
items.zh: “作弊”的鸟儿改变了态度

items.summary: A new fabrication platform integrates molecules into electronic devices, opening the door to emerging computing technologies.
items.zh: 将分子转变为可靠的电子设备

items.title: How fruit flies chase invisible ribbons of smell to get to their source

items.title: Not just Neanderthals: Ghost lineage in Africa left its mark on our DNA

items.title: To detect CTE while alive, a test for another brain disease may help
items.summary: A protein that is a hallmark of Alzheimer’s disease may also ID a brain condition associated with head trauma in contact sports, early findings suggest.

items.title: Is AI Reasoning Right for the Wrong Reasons?

items.zh: 人工智能的推理是否正确？

items.title: Why some nitrogen-processing enzymes are more efficient than others
